full_name: Orit Shaer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Engineering & Computer Science Sally Starling Seaver Fellow Wellesley College
bio: Orit Shaer is a professor of computer science at Wellesley College and a leading scholar in human-computer interaction whose work advances human-centered approaches to artificial intelligence for creativity, learning, and collaboration.
